text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Winning Ticket has safely
completed
her debut, it's time to decide
the next race to
enter.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... There are so many to choose
from. I
can't decide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not good at thinking so deeply!
Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket is peering at reference
books and
past data. She's trying her
hardest, but it seems
to be a struggle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My motivation renewed, I sit down to
draft a solid
race agenda.
choice_data_list: (As her Trainer, I've got to step up!)
(As her Trainer, I've got to give ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we're aiming for the Japanese Derby, I
need to
make sure Ticket gets the hang
of running longer
distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, my attention is drawn
to the
Hopeful Stakes—the longest of all
the junior G1
races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! That's a G1 race! Sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: Do your best and get great results!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Now it's really starting to feel
like I'm
competing in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our training for the Hopeful
Stakes
begins!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Here goes climb number
seven!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HOPEFUUUUL STAAAAKES!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is pouring all her strength in
running uphill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Elsewhere in the training grounds, I can
see her fellow Japanese Derby hopefuls,
Narita Taishin
and Biwa Hayahide, busy
with their own practice.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is doing time trials,
working on
improving her overall pace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is doing build-up runs to
develop
her speed and stamina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each in their own way, they're all
working toward
surpassing each another
when they eventually
meet in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Training continues on through the days,
and one
evening...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: How did I do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to measure her abilities, I'm
timing her runs on the 2,000 meter turf.
It's the same track
type as the Hopeful
Stakes, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our results aren't quite there yet.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! Even though I'm trying so hard?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: B-but why? I'm doing my best out there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is something troubling you, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahideeee! I'm really troubled!
Super-duper
troubled!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is a good friend to
Ticket. Maybe
she can help us figure
something out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're not reaching the times you'd like
to hit? I
see.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm not working hard enough...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If you want, we could have a scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it will solve your
problem, but it
may be a nice break from practice.
We might as
well invite Taishin too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So we decide to hold an impromptu
scrimmage
with the three friends
competing against each
other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the gates opening echoes
across the
track. I press my stopwatch as
they sprint off
together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then, same as usual!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide takes the lead, with
Winning
Ticket and Narita Taishin
chasing close behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually the three racers pass the
fourth corner
and head into the final
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin initiates her final spurt
and passes
Biwa Hayahide in one go!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You've gained more stamina,
Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hrrgh! Don't forget me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the back-and-forth between the two
in front
continues, Ticket lets out a
shout.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWAAAGH! I won't lose, I won't lose, I
WON'T
LOSE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She kicks up dirt, swinging her arms
forcefully, all
to reach the finish line
faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With pure determination gleaming in
their eyes,
all three fly across the finish
line almost
simultaneously!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Aw maaaan, I'm beat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Incredibly, the result is a three-way tie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Winning Ticket calms
down to her usual self, but I can't shake
the memory of the
sheer intensity she
showed just moments earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To confirm, I look at my stopwatch and
see...
she's beaten her personal record!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! I beat my fastest time?
YAAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's awesome! I wonder what got into
me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that plain as day? Your desire to
defeat us
pushed your muscles into a
higher gear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"UWAAAGH! I won't lose, I won't lose, I
WON'T
LOSE!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The intense determination to win that
Winning
Ticket showed during the
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's what she lacked during
regular
training—the pursuit of victory.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Hayahide! You're right! Hearing
your steps
dashing along with my own
made my heart beat
so loud!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Inside my chest... something went all
HRRAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that the presence of rivals to
compete
with is more important to
Ticket than I realized.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Hayahide! I finally
managed to
improve my time!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I'm glad I could assist in your
growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that satisfied smile on Biwa
Hayahide's
face, I realize something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No... I wasn't certain. However, I've had
a similar
experience myself, you see.
choice_data_list: Did you enter the race... knowing ...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was a chance that this
would be
just what Ticket needed too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Helping the enemy... Just how confident are you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I value her as a rival. If it's needed,
I'll
give a leg
up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Hayahide, are you giving up a
whole leg?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's just an expression, idiot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scrimmage ends with everyone
enjoying each
other's company.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rivalry... Maybe having rivals is the most

important thing for Ticket to perform
well in the
Twinkle Series.
